claims.statement: The MDR requires systematic post-market surveillance and, for class IIa, IIb, and III devices, periodic safety update reports; it also requires methods and thresholds for identifying statistically significant incident trends.

contrary_evidence: Manufacturers can perform these analyses within existing quality-management systems, and heterogeneous devices may make peer benchmarks invalid.

fingerprint.compounding_advantage: a minimum-cell-size benchmark across permissioned peer signals improves detection while raw data remains isolated
fingerprint.customer: EU micro and small manufacturers of comparable class IIa, IIb, or III medical devices
fingerprint.distribution_mechanism: MDR quality consultants and notified-body readiness specialists refer manufacturers
fingerprint.offer_and_business_model: segregated complaint ingestion, trend detection, peer benchmark, traceable analysis, and qualified-review workflow
fingerprint.payer_and_paid_event: the manufacturer pays at annual cooperative renewal and when an audit-ready evidence export is approved
fingerprint.problem_trigger: a PMS review, trend assessment, PSUR cycle, or notified-body audit is due

founder_fit: Strong biosignal, statistics, and health-domain fit, but launch requires external MDR and privacy experts and must avoid clinical decision-making.
risks: Sensitive vigilance data creates security and competition-law risk.
Bad pooling logic could conceal a safety signal.

structure.control_point: the statistically justified trend threshold and evidence export before periodic safety review or notified-body audit
structure.critical_dependency: manufacturer rights to contribute de-identified signals, sufficient comparable devices, and qualified regulatory review

thesis: Let micro and small medical-device manufacturers benchmark complaint and non-serious-incident trends against a privacy-preserving peer cohort, while producing their own PMS and PSUR evidence. The cooperative controls only derived benchmarks; raw manufacturer records remain segregated. All commercial numbers, including capital_required_pln, are unvalidated hypotheses.
title: Privacy-Preserving MDR Safety Signal Cooperative
uncertainties: A legally safe minimum viable cohort is unknown.
Notified-body acceptance of cooperative benchmarks is unvalidated.
